name: Signal Lost
description: Deep-field reconnaissance of an anomalous ringworld fragment. Lia's signal degrades as reality warps around the construct core. The operative must maintain cohesion while the environment rewrites itself.

dialogue.speaker: Lia
dialogue.line: Signal lost. I'm rerouting through the ring's backbone. This fragment feels... ancient. Like a save file from a corrupted playthrough.

dialogue.speaker: Oracle Prime
dialogue.line: Contact established. You are not the first to wake here. The ring remembers every failed run.

dialogue.speaker: Lia
dialogue.line: Seeker swarm neutralized. These bots are hunting signatures—ours specifically.

dialogue.speaker: Oracle Prime
dialogue.line: The chamber is sealed. The warning inside is meant for the Demon. Not Master Chief—Demon.

dialogue.speaker: Oracle Shade
dialogue.line: Interference detected. The ring is rewriting its own geometry. If you linger, you will be archived.

dialogue.speaker: Lia
dialogue.line: Chamber collapsing. I'm locking onto your beacon. Do not let go.

easter_eggs.name: CE Release Bug
easter_eggs.description: Fourth-wall break: the game acknowledges it is a build with known issues.
